sources.title: Command-Line Demo | VITA-MLLM/VITA | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This documentation covers the command-line interface for VITA, providing a step-by-step guide on using the video_audio_demo.py script for inference with the VITA multimodal model. This interface allows users to interact with the model using images, videos, and audio inputs directly from the command line. For information about the web-based interface, see Web Interface.
